note: An anonymised 12-team, 13-round snake with ten traded picks, in the shape of a real league's order: two positions swap a pair of early picks for a pair of late ones (1 and 4), two swap one pick each (7 and 10, 5 and 12), and two picks move one way (2 to 6, 9 to 3). Keys are overall picks, values the position that owns them instead of the snake's. Shared by the Python and the extension tests.
